entry_surfaces./: split hero layout — brand statement + cryptographic security status left, interactive client-side encrypted note creation engine with burn controls right
entry_surfaces./v/:id: interstitial zero-knowledge decrypt chamber — locked vault token card, optional client passphrase decryption input, and instant destruction warning reveal
entry_surfaces./wall: asymmetric high-density anonymous public wall — live decentralized feed with zero-metadata post composer and anti-surveillance verification badges
entry_surfaces./how-it-works: technical interactive security architecture ledger — Web Crypto AES-256-GCM client-side explanation, key-in-fragment proof, and zero-log guarantee breakdown

typography.pairing_strategy: High-impact Cyber-Editorial Sans (Space Grotesk) + Clean Geometric Body (DM Sans) + Cryptographic Monospace (JetBrains Mono)

layouts.grid_system: Asymmetric Bento with Technical Border Grid (MODE A & B hybrid)
layouts.container_padding: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 md:py-12

header.style: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0F]/80 border-b border-white/10 fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50

note_creator_section.left_col: Security telemetry: Zero-knowledge client encryption badge, key hash preview, ephemeral countdown timer settings, burn-after-read toggles
note_creator_section.right_col: Raw secret editor with optional passphrase shielding, real-time client-side entropy & ciphertext preview drawer

note_viewer_section.description: Never triggers immediate burn on crawler access; shows 'Locked Payload Detected' card requiring manual 'Decrypt & Reveal' click or passphrase entry, followed by a dramatic self-destruct notice and instant wipe from memory.

public_wall_section.description: Zero-metadata public thoughts. Anonymous identity hashing (e.g. 'Ghost-7f9a'), expiring posts or permastream, tags (confessions, thoughts, leaks, whistleblows), reaction counters without IP tracking (ephemeral upvotes), and zero cookies/fingerprinting

effects.terminal_typing: Subtle cipher text reveal effect for decrypted messages
effects.burn_animation: Disintegration / red particle burn effect when a note is destroyed
effects.border_glow: Subtle cyan edge glow on active and focused inputs
effects.page_transition: Opacity fade with 6px upward drift (0.2s ease-out)

accessibility.contrast_guarantee: All text elements meet at least 4.5:1 ratio against solid and image-scrimmed backgrounds
accessibility.focus_indicators: High-contrast 2px cyan ring (ring-2 ring-[#00F5FF]/60 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#090A0F])
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive buttons, textareas, inputs, dropdowns, and copy triggers MUST carry role-based kebab-case testids

hero_cyber_abstract.description: Abstract green-cyan matrix code flow with deep dark voids for cryptographic hero background overlay

security_abstract_visual.description: Cyber long exposure digital data streams in blue and orange against pure black

anonymity_mask_accent.description: Cyberpunk digital privacy masked figure for zero-tracking concept card

cryptography_spec_for_agent.key_transport: Decryption key embedded strictly in the URL hash fragment (#key=...), NEVER sent over HTTP to the backend
cryptography_spec_for_agent.passphrase_layer: If passphrase is provided, PBKDF2 with SHA-256 (100,000 iterations) + random salt derives an intermediate key before AES-GCM wrapping
cryptography_spec_for_agent.burn_policy: When burn_after_read is true, reading the ciphertext triggers immediate backend atomic deletion via MongoDB find_one_and_delete; subsequent accesses return 404/Destruction notice
cryptography_spec_for_agent.zero_metadata: Backend stores NO client IP, NO User-Agent, NO request headers. Only cipher_text, iv, salt (if any), expiry_at, burn_after_read, created_at.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement client-side Web Crypto helper utility in `frontend/src/lib/crypto.ts` with AES-256-GCM encryption, decryption, key generation, and URL fragment encoding.

Build the core pages: `Home.tsx` (Encrypted Secret Creator & Generated Link Card), `ViewSecret.tsx` (Locked Interstitial, Passphrase prompt, Decrypt & Burn notice), `AnonymousWall.tsx` (Zero-tracking public feed + post modal), `HowItWorks.tsx` (Zero-knowledge architecture visualizer with interactive crypto simulator).
Add route paths in `frontend/src/App.tsx` and ensure responsive navbar in `frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx` with links to all three main areas.

Ensure dark mode is default by editing `frontend/src/index.css` with `@import '@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk'; @import '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'; @import '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans';` and styling the root background `#090A0F`.

In backend (`backend/server.py` and `backend/routers/`): build endpoints `/api/secrets` (POST to store ciphertext, GET `/api/secrets/{id}` to fetch/burn), and `/api/wall` (GET public messages, POST new anonymous message with optional expiry).
Guarantee that all secret links generated look like `http://localhost:3000/v/<id>#key=<base64Key>` so the key never hits the server.

Provide high fidelity UI widgets: Burn-countdown visualizer, Clipboard 1-click copy with feedback toast via Sonner, QR code modal for mobile secret sharing, Encrypted Payload Hex viewer toggle, and Client Entropy visualizer bar.
Add extensive `data-testid` attributes to all inputs, buttons, copy actions, and secret displays.
